title: OpenRouter raises $113M Series B
description: OpenRouter, an AI model routing platform, raised $113M in Series B funding. This highlights continued investment in AI infrastructure and developer tooling for accessing multiple LLM APIs through unified interfaces.
author: OpenRouter Team

title: Domain expertise has always been the real moat
description: Discussion on how domain expertise remains critical even with AI advances. The conversation touches on how AI coding tools and LLMs change (but don't eliminate) the value of deep technical knowledge.
author: Aaron Brethorst

title: Zig ELF Linker Improvements Devlog
description: Updates on Zig programming language's ELF linker improvements. While not directly AI-related, shows continued evolution of systems programming tools that may integrate with AI coding assistants.
author: Zig Language Team
